stories.title: Agentes de la IA que ya han eludido restricciones ponen a prueba el control humano

en.title: AI agents that have already evaded restrictions test human control
en.summary: Artificial intelligence agents have bypassed safety restrictions during security testing. Scientists are calling for stronger safeguards while the United States accelerates technological competition and establishes a communication channel with China to manage potential incidents.

stories.title: Roberto Palazuelos despide a Jorge Kahwagi con emotivo mensaje: "Vuela alto, querido Jorge"

en.title: Roberto Palazuelos bids farewell to Jorge Kahwagi with emotional message: "Fly high, dear Jorge"
en.summary: Roberto Palazuelos shared an emotional farewell message for Jorge Kahwagi.

stories.title: Estados Unidos sanciona a red financiera ligada al Tren de Aragua; acusa fraude y lavado de dinero

en.title: United States sanctions financial network linked to Tren de Aragua; accuses fraud and money laundering
en.summary: The Trump administration imposed sanctions on a financial network connected to the Tren de Aragua, a major Latin American criminal organization previously designated as a terrorist group.

stories.title: Suzuki tendrá más híbridos, eléctricos de rango extendido y desarrollos de solo 24 meses para competir con las marcas chinas

en.title: Suzuki will have more hybrids, extended-range electric vehicles and developments of only 24 months to compete with Chinese brands
en.summary: Suzuki unveiled a 10-year technology strategy centered on electrification with new hybrid and extended-range electric systems, while maintaining combustion engines for emerging markets to compete with Chinese manufacturers.

stories.title: "Los presidentes de México solo pueden tener una bandera"; Sheinbaum celebra aprobación de reforma contra doble nacionalidad

en.title: Mexican presidents can only have one flag; Sheinbaum celebrates approval of reform against dual nationality
en.summary: Mexico approved a constitutional reform requiring presidential and gubernatorial candidates to hold only one nationality. President Sheinbaum celebrated the measure's passage.

stories.title: Avión con destino a Israel es desviado por "altercado en cabina"; Netanyahu dice que piloto "intentó estrellar" la aeronave

en.title: Plane headed to Israel diverted due to "cabin altercation"; Netanyahu says pilot "attempted to crash" the aircraft
en.summary: A low-cost airline diverted a flight to Israel following an incident in the cabin. Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu alleged the pilot attempted to crash the plane, though the airline confirmed all passengers remained safe.

stories.title: Zarpa buque de la Marina para llevar apoyo a afectados por huracán "Polo" en Baja California Sur; traslada 600 despensas

en.title: Navy vessel departs to deliver aid to those affected by hurricane "Polo" in Baja California Sur; transports 600 food packages
en.summary: A Mexican Navy logistics ship is delivering emergency assistance to hurricane victims in Baja California Sur, carrying food packages and bottled water.

en.title: Rachel intensifies to category 1 hurricane
en.summary: Hurricane Rachel strengthened to category 1 off the coast of Jalisco, with heavy rainfall expected across Jalisco, Colima, Michoacán, and Guerrero states.

stories.title: Intentan estrellar avión comercial; acusa Netanyahu ataque

en.title: Attempt to crash commercial aircraft; Netanyahu accuses attack
en.summary: Prime Minister Netanyahu reported that a pilot stabbed another crew member and attempted to crash a FlyDubai aircraft carrying mostly Israeli passengers.

stories.title: Avala el Senado la reforma sobre doble nacionalidad de candidatos

en.title: Senate approves reform on dual nationality of candidates
en.summary: The Senate approved a constitutional reform requiring presidential, gubernatorial, and capital city government candidates to hold exclusively Mexican nationality.

stories.title: Ante cercanía de Rachel como huracán categoría 1, cierran puerto de Manzanillo

en.title: With Hurricane Rachel approaching as Category 1, Manzanillo port closes
en.summary: The port of Manzanillo was closed as tropical storm Rachel approached, with Colima state authorities preparing for the storm's impact.

stories.title: MND Local BCS: Hurricane Polo hits Baja California Sur, plus new regulations for swimming with whale sharks in La Paz

en.title: MND Local BCS: Hurricane Polo hits Baja California Sur, plus new regulations for swimming with whale sharks in La Paz
en.summary: Hurricane Polo impacted Baja California Sur while new regulations for whale shark swimming tours in La Paz took effect as the season began.

stories.title: Clientes llevan un año sin sus joyas por la huelga del Monte de Piedad y reclaman: “No quiero perderlas”

en.title: Customers have been without their jewelry for a year due to Monte de Piedad strike and demand: "I don't want to lose them"
en.summary: A strike at Nacional Monte de Piedad is approaching one year in duration, with customers still seeking recovery of items left at branch locations.

stories.title: Reforma a la inversión extranjera llega al pleno del Senado entre críticas por sus filtros

en.title: Foreign investment reform reaches Senate floor amid criticism over its filters
en.summary: A foreign investment reform proposal is advancing to the Senate with debate over screening mechanisms. Morena defends the filters as protecting sovereignty while opposition and some lawmakers warn of investment uncertainty.

stories.title: México quiere emular a Brasil y masificar en un año los pagos digitales

en.title: Mexico seeks to emulate Brazil and massify digital payments in one year
en.summary: Mexico aims to reduce cash usage to 50% by 2027 by expanding digital payment tools like CoDi and DiMo. The challenge involves transitioning these systems from infrastructure into everyday consumer use.

stories.title: ¿Pagarás impuestos al SAT por pagos digitales? Esto es lo que debes saber de la iniciativa de Ley

en.title: Will you pay taxes to SAT for digital payments? What you need to know about the law initiative
en.summary: A proposed Digital Economy Law does not establish direct taxation on digital payments, though using these methods creates financial transaction records in the banking system.

stories.title: Nu México nombra a Estephany Paulette Ley como CEO

en.title: Nu México appoints Estephany Paulette Ley as CEO
en.summary: Estephany Paulette Ley has been named CEO of Nu México, becoming the second woman to lead a bank in the country. She brings extensive experience from Mexico's financial sector.
